name: vsconfig

version.description: The version of the component configuration file format.

components.description: An array of Visual Studio component names.

extensions.description: An array of Visual Studio extensions. These can be URLs to marketplace extensions or paths to private VSIX files.

schema.title: JSON schema for Visual Studio component configuration files

description:
The Visual Studio configuration is based on version 1.0.0.0. It includes the following components: the .NET Framework 4.6 targeting pack (Microsoft.Net.Component.4.6.TargetingPack), the Managed Desktop workload (Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.ManagedDesktop), and the F# language component (Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.FSharp).  

In addition to these core components, we will install two extensions: the C++ tools extension from the Marketplace at https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-vscode.cpptools, and a custom private extension located at C:\extensions\MyCustomExtension.vsix.
